mapper.insert: INSERT INTO work (com_id, user_code, work_name, schema_content) VALUES (#{comId}, #{userCode}, #{workName}, #{schemaContent}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE work_name = VALUES(work_name), schema_content = VALUES(schema_content)
mapper.select: SELECT w.id, w.work_name, w.schema_content FROM work w WHERE w.com_id = #{comId} AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM review r WHERE r.com_id = w.com_id AND r.user_code = w.user_code AND r.accept = 1 ) ORDER BY w.id DESC

SELECT w.id, w.work_name, w.user_code, c.name AS comName, t.name AS teamName, t.member AS memberJson, u.name AS captainName, w.schema_content, -- 审核结论（true=通过 / false=未通过 / null=未审核）与审核意见。 -- 用子查询而不是 JOIN：不依赖 review 的唯一键，review 有重复行时也不会把作品导出成多行 (SELECT r.accept FROM review r WHERE r.com_id = w.com_id AND r.user_code = w.user_code LIMIT 1) AS review_accept, (SELECT r.opinion FROM review r WHERE r.com_id = w.com_id AND r.user_code = w.user_code LIMIT 1) AS review_opinion FROM work w JOIN team t ON t.com_id = w.com_id AND t.captain = w.user_code LEFT JOIN user u ON u.code = w.user_code JOIN competition c ON c.id = w.com_id WHERE w.com_id = #{comId} ORDER BY w.id DESC
